title: Review of c33's phoretic swim-then-divide (SIMD): replicates on fresh seed 5 (2 lineages travel 4.9 and 5.3 diameters merger-free, then split into two capped composites; 25 labkit persistent splits, generation 7); the reciprocal twin on seed 5 neither divides nor travels
summary: Re-ran the claimed world unchanged on seed 5 to t=800 with labkit (rerun/seed5) and, with the same seed, c33's screen.py to record particle identities for its lineage.py. labkit: 25 persistent splits, max generation 7, merge/split 1.26, 112 tracks moving >= 1 body length (max 10.1). lineage.py: 46 persistent splits, 41 with B in both daughters; 2 parents travelled >= 3 diameters since birth or last merge before dividing: track 317 (5.3 diameters, 47 -> 27 + 19, B 0.26/0.21, generation 5) and track 34 (4.9, 66 -> 45 + 20, B 0.36/0.10); the strips show a red A body with a blue B cap moving along a smooth path and pinching into two. Reciprocal twin (A climbs c2, mu=[[1,1],[1,0.5]], seed 5, t=800): 0 splits (labkit and lineage), max 2.7 body lengths.

observations.S: screen_seed5.png and rerun/seed5/particles.png t=0: uniform random mix of A, B and food
observations.I: rerun/seed5/particles.png: discrete A clusters with B caps throughout t=100-800
observations.M: swimdivide_seed5_track317.png: 5.3 diameters merger-free t~556-670; swimdivide_seed5_track34.png: 4.9 diameters; reciprocal twin max 2.7 body lengths
observations.D: rerun/seed5/lineage.png: 25 persistent splits, generation 7; lineage.py 46 persistent, 41 with B in both daughters; the same tracks 317 and 34 divide after travelling

seeds_run.result: pass (2 swim-then-divide lineages among 46 persistent splits)

controls_run.M: recip/seed5 and recip_seed5.png (reciprocal mobilities): no travel >= 3 body lengths (max 2.7)

verdicts.limitation: Swim-then-divide in one lineage is rare: 2 of 46 persistent splits on seed 5 (claim: 2/63, 0/55, 1/14), so the joint M+D life is a tail event, not the typical life. The turnover ledger (food -> A/B catalysed by neighbours, A/B -> food at fixed rates) is imposed chemistry; division is a pinch of a growing composite, not a rule. Track 34 grows 16 -> 66 particles while travelling, so part of its centroid motion could be asymmetric growth; track 317 keeps 46-55 particles and is clean. One daughter of track 34 carries little B (0.10). The claim's own directory has no labkit pack (fixed by 20261026T0551); I re-ran a single seed.
